name: texinfo
description: The Texinfo package contains programs for reading, writing, and converting info pages.

installed_descriptions.name: info
installed_descriptions.description: Used to read info pages which are similar to man pages, but often go much deeper than just explaining all the available command line options [For example, compare man bison and info bison.]

installed_descriptions.name: install-info
installed_descriptions.description: Used to install info pages; it updates entries in the info index file

installed_descriptions.name: makeinfo
installed_descriptions.description: Translates the given Texinfo source documents into info pages, plain text, or HTML

installed_descriptions.name: pdftexi2dvi
installed_descriptions.description: Used to format the given Texinfo document into a Portable Document Format (PDF) file

installed_descriptions.name: texi2any
installed_descriptions.description: Translate Texinfo source documentation to various other formats

installed_descriptions.name: texi2dvi
installed_descriptions.description: Used to format the given Texinfo document into a device-independent file that can be printed

installed_descriptions.name: texi2pdf
installed_descriptions.description: Used to format the given Texinfo document into a Portable Document Format (PDF) file

installed_descriptions.name: texindex
installed_descriptions.description: Used to sort Texinfo index files
